DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 展示の年代をご覧になっていましたね。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You were looking at the exhibit's dates, weren't you?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 祖父から聞いた話は、この説明より後の時代でした。同じ出来事でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族の話と展示年代が一致するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The story I heard from my grandfather was from a later period than this description. Is it the same event?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether your family's story matches the exhibit's period. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お聞きになった場所や出来事の名称は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the location or name of the event you heard about?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名称は聞いていません。祖父が体験した話なのか、さらに前の話なのかも曖昧です。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 話の名称と体験者が未確認だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't heard its name. I'm also unclear whether my grandfather experienced it himself or it was from an even earlier time.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the story's name and who experienced it are unconfirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それだけでは同じ出来事とは判断できませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can't determine that it's the same event from that alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 展示が間違っていると思っていましたが、まず家族の話の出所を調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 展示の誤りを決めつけず家族側の出所を調べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought the exhibit was wrong, but I'll first investigate the source of my family's story.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not assume the exhibit is wrong; investigate the family story's source. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 展示については、解説担当に資料の根拠をお尋ねいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: For the exhibit, you can ask the interpretation staff about the evidence behind the materials.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 担当の方には年代の根拠だけ質問します。祖父の話を証拠だとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 展示担当には資料の根拠を限定して質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask the staff only about the basis for the dates. I won't present my grandfather's story as evidence.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Limit your question to the exhibit staff to the evidence behind the materials. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのように分けると、質問が伝わりやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Separating them that way makes your question clearer.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 展示番号と年代を控えます。祖父には、誰から聞いた話か改めて尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 展示情報を控え祖父に伝聞の出所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll note the exhibit number and dates. I'll ask my grandfather again whom he heard the story from.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Note the exhibit information and ask your grandfather the source of the story he heard. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、調べる手掛かりになれば幸いです。それでは、ごゆっくりどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, I hope that gives you a starting point for your research. Please enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 処方箋のお預かりでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you dropping off a prescription?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は処方箋ではありません。整理中に以前の薬が出てきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 処方箋ではなく発見した古い薬の相談だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not a prescription today. I found some old medicine while tidying up.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want advice about old medicine you found, rather than a prescription. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 薬の扱いについて、薬剤師が伺います。包装は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The pharmacist will ask about how to handle it. Do you still have the packaging?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前のある袋はありますが、いつの薬か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋は残るが処方時期が不明だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the bag with a name on it, but I don't know when the medicine is from.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the bag remains but the prescription date is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中身をほかの容器へ移さず、そのままお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please show it as it is without transferring the contents to another container.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族が使えるかと思いましたが、渡す前に相談したくて来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族への流用前に相談する目的を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought a family member might be able to use it, but I came to ask before handing it over.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that your purpose is to consult before giving it to a family member to use. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人以外に使わせないでください。確認する情報を薬剤師がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please don't let anyone other than the prescribed person use it. The pharmacist will explain what information needs checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族には渡しません。捨て方も、薬剤師に聞いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族に渡さず処分方法も薬剤師に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't give it to my family. May I ask the pharmacist how to dispose of it too?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not give it to family; ask the pharmacist about disposal too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、お持ちの薬について相談していただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, you can consult about the medicine you have.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 袋ごとお見せします。古い薬を今の薬と一緒にするのもやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋のまま提示し現在の薬と混ぜないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show it in its bag. I also won't mix the old medicine with my current medicine.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show it in the bag and decide not to mix it with current medicine. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 服用の相談と処分方法を薬剤師へ引き継ぎます。相談まで古い薬と今の薬は分けてお持ちください。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass the questions about use and disposal to the pharmacist. Keep the old and current medicines separate until your consultation. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お取引のご本人様でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you the account holder for this transaction?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父のカードを預かっています。父の代わりに手続きをしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 父のカードを預かった代理来店だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm holding my father's card. I'd like to carry out a procedure on his behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you have come as a representative with your father's card. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: カードを持っていることだけでは、ご本人様の手続きとはなりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Having the card alone does not make this an in-person procedure by the account holder.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本人になりすますつもりはありません。代理の手続きとして必要なものを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人のふりではなく代理条件の照会だと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I don't intend to impersonate him. I'd like to ask what is needed to act as his representative.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Make clear that you are asking about representative requirements, not pretending to be him. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 内容を伺ってから、必要な確認をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: After hearing the details, we'll explain the necessary checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 父の住所が変わりました。私の口座の住所ではなく、父の登録情報です。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 父の登録住所変更という手続き内容を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: My father's address has changed. It's his registered information, not the address on my account.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State that the procedure is a change of your father's registered address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 代理で受け付けられるかを含め、担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check with the person in charge, including whether we can accept it through a representative.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 父に来店してもらう必要があるなら、その旨を伝えます。暗証番号は話しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人来店が必要なら伝え暗証番号を開示しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If my father needs to come in, I'll tell him. I won't disclose the PIN.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to tell him if an in-person visit is needed and not disclose the PIN. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 暗証番号はお聞きしません。ご本人様のご意思の確認も必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We won't ask for the PIN. We also need to confirm the account holder's wishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は条件を聞いて持ち帰り、父に確認してから進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件を持ち帰り本人の意思確認後に進める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Today I'll take the requirements home and proceed after checking with my father.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take the requirements home and proceed after confirming the account holder's wishes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お父様に確認してから進めたいご希望を担当へ伝えます。条件の説明を持ち帰って、ご本人とご相談ください。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell the person in charge that you wish to check with your father before proceeding. Take the requirements explanation home and discuss it with him. Take care.

DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お守りをご覧ですか。ご自分用ですか、それともどなたかへお渡しになりますか。
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at protective charms? Is it for yourself or someone else?

DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 試験を受ける妹へ渡したいです。この二つは色だけが違うのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受験する妹へ渡すため二つのお守りが色違いだけか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to give one to my younger sister, who's taking an exam. Do these two differ only in color?
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether two charms differ only in color, for your younger sister who is taking an exam. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの見本は、色と表に書かれた言葉が異なります。書かれた文字を一緒に見ますか。
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-03.translation: These samples differ in color and in the words written on the front. Shall we look at the writing together?

DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。妹に意味を説明したいので、短く読み方も教えてください。
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 妹への説明用に札を見て短い意味と読み方を教えてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, please. I'd like to explain the meaning to my sister, so please briefly tell me how to read it too.
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Look at the label and ask for a brief meaning and reading to explain to your sister. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 説明の札を見ながらお伝えします。妹さんは今日いらっしゃっていますか。
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll explain while looking at the label. Is your sister here today?

DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は来ていません。自分が代わりに受ける場合の案内と、渡すまでの持ち方を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 妹が来ておらず代わりに受ける案内と渡すまでの持ち方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not today. I'd like guidance on receiving one on her behalf and how to keep it until I give it to her.
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain your sister is absent and ask about receiving it on her behalf and keeping it until handover. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その点は授与の案内で確認しましょう。持ち帰る袋についてもご希望がありますか。
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check that in the charm distribution guidance. Do you also have a preference for a bag to take it home?

DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 鞄の中でほかの荷物と混ざらないよう、小さな袋をお願いできるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ほかの荷物と混ざらないよう小袋を用意できるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to check whether I could have a small bag so it won't get mixed up with other things in my handbag.
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check whether a small bag is available to keep it separate from other luggage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 袋の用意について確かめます。選ぶ前に、まだ読みたい札はありますか。
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check about a bag. Are there any other labels you'd like to read before choosing?

DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この札も読んでから選びます。妹には結果を約束するものとしてではなく、応援の気持ちと一緒に渡します。
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 札を読んで選び試験結果の保証ではなく応援として妹へ渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll read this label too before choosing. I'll give it to my sister with my encouragement, rather than as a promise of an exam result.
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Read the labels, choose, and give it to your sister as encouragement rather than a guarantee of exam results. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お気持ちが伝わるとよいですね。札をご覧になってお選びください。お帰りの道もお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-FKO-DAZAIFU-001-SHARED-11.translation: I hope your feelings reach her. Please read the labels and choose. Take care on your way home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お配りになるお菓子をお探しですか。何人分をご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for sweets to hand out? How many people are you planning for?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 最初は六人でしたが、別の部署の四人にも渡すことになりました。大きな箱一つで足りるか見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 六人に四人が加わり大箱一つで足りるか確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Originally six, but now I'll also give some to four people in another department. I'd like to see whether one large box is enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that four people have been added to six and you want to check whether one large box is sufficient. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 箱の入り数を見比べましょう。一人ずつ別の日に渡す予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's compare the number in each box. Will you hand them to people individually on different days?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、三日に分けて渡します。個別に包まれているかと、表示の日付を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三日に分けて配るため個包装と表示日付を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, over three days. I'd like to check whether they're individually wrapped and the date on the label.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check individual wrapping and the labeled date because you will distribute them over three days. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この見本で包装を確認できます。持ち帰った後の置き場所は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can check the wrapping on this sample. Have you decided where to keep them after taking them home?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 職場の机に置くつもりでした。保存の表示に合う場所か分からないので、そこも読んでから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 職場机に置く予定だが保存表示に合うか読んで判断すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was planning to put them on my desk at work. I don't know whether that meets the storage labeling, so I'll read that too before deciding.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain you planned to use your workplace desk but will read the storage label before deciding whether it is suitable. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示を確認して選びましょう。箱の数を増やす場合、予算について希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the labeling before choosing. If you need more boxes, do you have a budget preference?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一箱の値段ではなく、必要な人数分の合計で予算と比べたいです。二つの候補で合計を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要人数の総額を予算と比べるため二候補の合計を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to compare the total for everyone with my budget, rather than the price of one box. Please tell me the totals for two options.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request the totals for two options to compare the cost for all recipients with your budget. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入り数と合計を並べてご案内します。袋を分けて持ち帰る必要もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll show the quantities and totals side by side. Do you also need separate bags to take them home?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 部署ごとに分けたいので、袋の用意ができるか聞きたいです。人数と表示を確認してから箱を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋を分けられるか尋ね人数と表示を見て箱を選ぶと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'd like to separate them by department, so I'd like to ask if bags are available. I'll choose the boxes after checking the number of people and labels.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about separate bags and say you will choose boxes after checking recipient numbers and labeling. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、十人分で候補を比べましょう。お渡しする準備が整うとよいですね。お気をつけてお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's compare options for ten people. I hope your preparations for giving them go well. Please take care carrying them home.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この絵をお探しでしたか。お手元の写真と見比べていらっしゃいますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Were you looking for this painting? You're comparing it with your photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 案内で見た絵だと思いましたが、写真には木が二本あり、こちらには一本しかありません。別の作品でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真の二本の木と展示の一本の木を比べ別作品か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought it was the painting I saw in the guide, but the photo has two trees and this has only one. Is it a different work?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Compare the photo's two trees with the exhibit's one and ask whether it is a different work. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 似た構図でも別の作品かもしれません。写真の下に題名はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: It may be a different work despite a similar composition. Is there a title below the photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さく書いてあります。絵の横の札と照合したいので、この題名の読み方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真の題名を札と比較するため読み方を教えてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's written in small letters. Please tell me how to read this title so I can compare it with the label beside the painting.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how to read the photographed title so you can compare it with the label. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 題名を確かめましょう。近くで札を見るときも、作品には触れないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the title. Please do not touch the work when looking at the label up close either.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 札だけ近くで読みます。絵全体を見るには、どのくらい離れて立てばほかの人の邪魔になりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 札だけ近くで読み全体を見る位置が通行を妨げないか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll read only the label up close. How far away should I stand to view the whole painting without getting in others' way?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read only the label up close and ask where to view the whole work without blocking passage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 床の表示と通路の空き具合を見て位置を選びましょう。写真に撮る予定もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's choose a position based on the floor markings and space in the passage. Are you planning to take photos too?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 記録は撮影案内を確認してからにします。今は、この絵の光の描き方について説明を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 撮影案内は後で確かめ今は光の描き方の説明を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check the photography guidance before taking a record photo. For now, I'd like to hear about how the light is painted in this work.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check photography guidance later and ask now about how light is painted. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 展示の解説にある部分からご案内します。見つけた違いも感想として書いておきますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll explain the parts covered by the exhibit commentary. Would you like to write down the differences you noticed as your impressions too?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。題名を間違えないようにメモし、写真の絵との違いと光の印象を自分の言葉で残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正しい題名をメモし写真との差と光の印象を自分の言葉で書く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll note the title correctly and record the differences from the painting in the photo and my impressions of the light in my own words.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Note the correct title and write the differences from the photo and your impressions of the light in your own words. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、解説を見ながらお話ししましょう。ご自分のペースで、よい鑑賞を。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's talk while looking at the commentary. Enjoy viewing at your own pace.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗換えに使うバスをお探しですね。到着後はどちらへ向かわれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking for a bus to make a connection, correct? Where will you go after arriving?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 別のバスに乗り換えます。同じ都市名が出ている二つの便なら、どちらでも乗換場所に着くと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ都市名の二便ならどちらも乗換場所に着くと思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll transfer to another bus. I thought either of two services displaying the same city name would take me to the connection point.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you assumed both services with the same city name would reach your transfer point. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 都市名だけでなく、到着する停留所も確認しましょう。乗換先の予約案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the arrival stops as well as the city name. Do you have your onward reservation information?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あります。ここに停留所名が書いてあるので、この二便の到着場所と見比べてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乗換先の案内を示し二便の到着場所と比べてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. The stop name is written here. Could you compare it with the arrival locations for these two services?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the onward information and ask to compare the two services' arrival locations. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 停留所名を照合します。乗換えの間に、荷物を受け取って移動する必要もありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll compare the stop names. You also need to collect your luggage and move between services.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 大きな鞄を預ける予定です。降りる場所から次の乗り場まで、歩く時間も考えて選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 預ける大鞄があり次の乗り場まで歩く時間も考えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I plan to check a large bag. I'd like to choose taking into account the walking time from where I get off to the next boarding point too.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain you will have a checked large bag and want to account for walking time to the next boarding point. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内で移動経路を確認しましょう。ぎりぎりの時刻だけで選ばないほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the walking route in the information. It's better not to choose only by a barely possible timing.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 到着予定の差だけで決めず、乗り場の位置と移動の余裕を確かめます。切符はまだ買いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 到着時刻差だけで決めず場所と移動余裕を調べ切符を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't decide only by the difference in scheduled arrivals; I'll check the boarding points and time to move. I won't buy a ticket yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check locations and transfer allowance rather than just arrival-time differences, and hold off on tickets. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認が済んでから候補を絞れますね。乗換先の予約時刻も一緒に見ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you've checked, you can narrow the choices. Shall we look at your onward reservation time too?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。停留所名と時刻の両方を案内で確認し、自分でメモした時刻とも照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約案内の名前と時刻を確認し自分のメモとも照合すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please. I'll check both the stop name and time in the information and compare them with the time I wrote down myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the reservation information's name and time and compare them with your own note. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、二つの案内を並べて見ましょう。荷物のお受け取りも忘れず、よいご旅行を。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's put the two sets of information side by side. Don't forget to collect your luggage. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文の前に確認したいことがあると伺いました。どのような内容でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: I heard you want to check something before ordering. What is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 卵アレルギーがあります。肉だけなら大丈夫と思いかけましたが、たれの原材料も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 卵アレルギーがあり肉だけで判断せずたれの材料を聞きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have an egg allergy. I almost assumed meat alone would be all right, but I'd also like to check the sauce ingredients.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your egg allergy and ask about sauce ingredients instead of judging by meat alone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 調理担当に確認します。今考えている料理と、使いたい調味料を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check with the kitchen. Please tell me which dish you're considering and which seasonings you want to use.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この盛合せです。添えてあるたれだけでなく、肉に下味が付いているかも聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 盛合せを示し添付のたれと肉の下味について聞いてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: This assortment. Please ask not just about the sauce served with it, but also whether the meat is preseasoned.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point to the assortment and ask about both the accompanying sauce and the meat's preseasoning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 下味も含めて確認します。共用する道具や調理場所についてもご心配がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the preseasoning too. Are you also concerned about shared utensils and cooking areas?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。同じ道具や場所で卵を使う料理も扱うか、分かる範囲を確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 卵を扱う料理と道具や調理場所を共有するか確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Please check, as far as you can find out, whether the same utensils and areas handle dishes containing egg too.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request confirmation of whether utensils and preparation areas are shared with egg dishes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できたことと、確認できないことを分けてお伝えします。答えが出るまで注文は待ちますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll distinguish what we can confirm from what we cannot. Would you like to hold the order until we have an answer?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 待ちます。卵を使わないという言葉だけで判断せず、分からない点が残る場合は注文を控えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 材料だけで安全と決めず回答を待ち不明点が残れば頼まないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't judge just from the words 'no egg used'; if anything remains unclear, I won't order it.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Wait for the answer without deciding safety from ingredients alone, and do not order if uncertainty remains. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご一緒の方もこの盛合せを食べる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. Was your companion planning to eat this assortment too?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人と分けるつもりでしたが、確認が済むまでは私の分も含めて頼まないよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 共有する予定だった友人に確認前は自分の分も頼まないよう知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I was going to share it with my friend, but I'll tell them not to order it, including my portion, until the checks are complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell the friend you planned to share with not to order your portion either until confirmation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、調理担当に尋ねてきます。確認をお待ちいただきありがとうございます。お帰りもどうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll ask the kitchen. Thank you for waiting for the checks. Take care on your way home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの紙についてですね。ご自身で相談の予約をされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: It's about the paper you have, correct? Have you booked a consultation yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだしていません。この訪問の案内が入っていたので、水道の相談もその日にできると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約していないが訪問日に水道相談もできると思っていたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. This visit notice was delivered, so I thought I could discuss my plumbing that day too.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you have not booked but thought plumbing advice was available on the visit date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 訪問案内と相談の受付は別の内容かもしれません。何を相談したいのか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The visit notice and consultation reception may be separate matters. Please tell me what you want to discuss.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家の水道設備について分からない点があります。案内の作業をお願いしたいという話ではなく、説明を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 訪問作業の依頼ではなく自宅設備の説明を聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: There are things I don't understand about my home's plumbing equipment. I'm not asking for the work in the notice; I'd like an explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want information about your home equipment, not to request the announced visit work. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 用件を分けて確認しましょう。相談したい設備の名前や写真はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check those requests separately. Do you have the equipment's name or photos?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前は分かりませんが、写真があります。場所が分かるよう全体も撮って、担当に見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 設備名は不明だが位置が分かる全体写真を担当に見せたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't know its name, but I have a photo. I'd also like to take a wider photo showing its location and have the person in charge look at it.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the equipment name is unknown but you want staff to see a wider photo showing its position. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真を使う相談の方法も担当に確認します。連絡を受ける時間に希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll also check how to consult using photos. Do you have a preferred time to be contacted?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 日中は仕事なので、相談できる連絡方法と時間帯を案内で確かめたいです。訪問日を相談予約とは扱いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 昼は仕事のため方法と時間帯を確かめ訪問日を予約扱いしないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I work during the day, so I'd like to check the consultation contact methods and hours in the guidance. I won't treat the visit date as a consultation appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain daytime work, check contact methods and times, and do not treat the visit as a consultation booking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付方法が分かったら、相談の準備も確認できますね。今の紙は保管しておきますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you know how to apply, you can also check what to prepare. Will you keep the paper you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 保管します。訪問案内の確認事項と自分の設備の質問を別々にメモし、担当に混ぜずに伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 訪問紙を保管し案内への確認と設備質問を別々にメモして伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll separately note questions about the visit notice and my equipment, and explain them to the person in charge without mixing them.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the notice, note the notice checks and equipment questions separately, and convey them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、二つの用件を分けてご案内します。紙と写真をお忘れなく、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll explain the two matters separately. Don't forget your paper and photos, and take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 昨日のご注文についてのご相談ですね。購入した品は、どのような状態でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to discuss yesterday's order. What was the item you bought like?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 薄切りを頼んだつもりですが、開けると厚い肉が入っていました。注文がどう伝わっていたか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 薄切り希望だったが厚い肉が入り注文の伝わり方を確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I meant to ask for thin slices, but when I opened it, the meat was thick. I'd like to check how my order was understood.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you wanted thin slices but received thick meat and want to check how the order came across. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 購入の状況を確かめます。どの料理に使うとお話しされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the purchase circumstances. What dish did you say you would use it for?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 鍋に入れると伝えました。厚さを数値で指定したわけではないので、こちらの言い方も説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 鍋用と伝え厚さを数値指定していない言い方も説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I said I'd put it in a hot pot. I didn't specify a numerical thickness, so I'll explain my own wording too.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you said it was for hot pot and did not specify thickness numerically. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その点も含めて伺います。袋の表示とレシートはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask about that too. Do you have the bag label and receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 両方あります。別の買い物の袋と取り違えていないか、自分でも表示を見比べました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 表示とレシートがあり他の買い物袋との取り違えを照合したと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Both. I also compared the labels myself to check whether I'd mixed it up with another shopping bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have the label and receipt and checked for a mix-up with another purchase's bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認してくださったのですね。肉は調理しましたか、それともそのままですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you for checking. Have you cooked the meat or left it as it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ調理していません。ここへ持って来る前に、確認のために必要な物と持参方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 調理しておらず現物の確認に必要な物と持参方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I haven't cooked it yet. Before bringing it here, I'd like to ask what you need for checking it and how to bring it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain it is uncooked and ask what is needed to check the item and how to bring it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ状況を伝え、確認方法をご案内します。今、何を一番確かめたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell the person in charge the situation and explain how we can check. What do you most want to clarify now?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 交換できると先に決めず、注文と商品の対応をまず確認したいです。次は希望の厚さを見本で伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 交換前提にせず注文商品対応を確かめ次回は厚さを見本で伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I don't want to assume an exchange is possible; first I want to check how the order corresponds to the product. Next time I'd like to show a sample of my desired thickness.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check order-product correspondence without assuming an exchange, and use a sample for thickness next time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。表示と注文時のお話を担当に確認します。ご相談ありがとうございました。お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKO-DAZAIFU-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll check the labeling and what was said during the order with the person in charge. Thank you for consulting us. Take care going home.
